pyq_bad.why: suspect key: order is Buxar, Clive's return, Allahabad, Hastings = 3,1,2,4 (option 2), not 1,2,3,4; stem truncated

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact Nawab identification: Mir Qasim abolished internal duties; Diwani year 1765; duty-free trade beyond Bengal (Awadh).
Recurring: Nawab at Buxar = Mir Jafar; Mughal at Buxar = Shah Alam II; Diwani granted by Shah Alam II during Clive's tenure.
Buxar as 'most decisive' battle and capital shift to Munger are classic one-liners.
Chronology items (Buxar-Clive's return-Allahabad-Hastings; 18th-century battles) recur in UPPSC/UPSC.
App matches the PYQ shapes well; it adds deeper Treaty of Allahabad and Dual Government statement items.
